analysis: The only change in ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler.swift is a rename of the model-admission predicate from autopilotAllowsModel to autopilotServesModel, at two call sites: throwIfRefusingNewLocalWork (line 135) and the authoritative pre-acceptance autopilot check (line 513). Both sites keep their structure: the same negation, the same autopilotCommand != nil check and the same autopilotManagesResidency && modelSlots[modelId] == nil clause. The authoritative check still runs after all admission awaits and before acceptedLifecycleRequests.insert, inferenceAccepted and requestToModel registration, so the atomic drain and admission ordering is preserved. I also reviewed the surrounding handler: decrypt, the sender-key length check, rejection of reserved tool-schema metadata, the decode-error log that omits the raw error, the encryption-failure path that fails closed with a terminal error rather than emitting plaintext (T-008), and the cacheScope plumbing (coordinator-authored scope, caching disabled when absent). None of these changed. The diff does not include the definition of autopilotServesModel, so I cannot confirm its semantics match autopilotAllowsModel. If it is weaker, for example if it allows models the autopilot did not select, the authoritative admission gate would be weakened for both network and local work. This is an unverified contract, so it is not a finding. The next pass should check the autopilotServesModel implementation, which is likely in a different file in the PR, to confirm it is at least as restrictive as before and still fails closed. It should also check that managed-residency warm-only behavior is preserved. No changes to cache, encryption, attestation or key handling appear in this unit.
